extName.message: Chrono – Finish Time & Speed for YouTube
extName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser's extension list and the stores.

extShortName.description: Short extension name. Also the accessible name of the Panel.

extDescription.message: See how long a YouTube video really takes at your speed, and when you'll finish.
extDescription.description: Extension description, shown in the browser's extension list.

remaining.description: Remaining watch time at the current speed, e.g. "12:30 left at 1.5×".

finishTime.description: The clock time at which the video will end, e.g. "ends 3:45 PM".

playerBadgeFinishTime.description: The Player badge: the video's finish time, shown after the player's own time display ("0:03 / 10:34 · ends 3:45 PM"). The dot separates it from YouTube's times.

pausedForAd.description: Shown in place of the remaining and finish time while YouTube plays an ad, when Chrono pauses its calculations.

live.description: Shown in place of the remaining and finish time on a live stream or a premiere, which have no fixed end.

slower.description: Accessible name of the Panel's − button, which lowers the speed by 0.25×.

faster.description: Accessible name of the Panel's + button, which raises the speed by 0.25×.

details.description: Accessible name of the Panel's expandable details area and of the button that expands and collapses it.

speedTable.description: Accessible name of the list of common speeds, each with its remaining watch time and finish time.

speedTableRow.description: Accessible name of a speed table row, which applies that speed when clicked, e.g. "1.5×: 8:20 left, ends 3:08 PM".

chapterScope.description: Label of the Chapter scope, which shows the chapter the playhead is in. Also its accessible name.

chapterSpeedTable.description: Accessible name of the Chapter scope's list of common speeds, each with the chapter's remaining watch time and finish time.

playlistSpeedTable.description: Accessible name of the Playlist scope's list of common speeds, each with the playlist's remaining watch time and finish time up to the target entry.

moreActions.description: Accessible name of the Panel's ⋮ menu button and of the menu it opens.

settings.description: Heading of Chrono's settings in the toolbar popup.

playerBadge.description: Setting: whether the video's finish time shows next to the player's own time display.

clockFormat.description: Setting: how finish times are written.

clockFormatAuto.description: Clock format choice: follow the browser's language and region.

clockFormat12h.description: Clock format choice: times like 3:45 PM.

showChapterScope.description: Setting: whether the Panel shows the current chapter's remaining and finish time on a video with chapters.

showPlaylistScope.description: Setting: whether the Panel shows the remaining and finish time for the rest of the playlist.

playlistScope.description: Heading of the Playlist scope: the current video plus the following playlist entries up to the target entry.

playlistTarget.description: Label of the input that chooses the last playlist entry the Playlist scope counts, by its number in the playlist.

playlistPartial.description: Note in the Playlist scope when YouTube has loaded only part of the playlist, e.g. "first 200 of 412 counted".

playlistUnavailable.description: Note in the Playlist scope: how many private, deleted or otherwise unavailable entries it skips, e.g. "3 unavailable".

playlistShuffle.message: Shuffle is on, so no playlist estimate
playlistShuffle.description: Shown in place of the Playlist scope's times while the playlist's Shuffle button is on.

panelStartsExpanded.description: Setting: whether the Panel's details are open when a watch page opens.

popupNote.message: Chrono works on YouTube watch and playlist pages.
popupNote.description: Note in the toolbar popup saying where Chrono shows up.
